items.title: The diagonal of a representable transformation of functors is representable
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for functors F, G on (Sch/S)_{fppf}^{opp} and a representable transformation a : F -> G, the relative diagonal Delta_{F/G} : F -> F x_G F is representable (source lines 456-462). The proof takes an arbitrary U and a pair xi = (xi_1, xi_2) in (F x_G F)(U), uses representability of a to represent h_U x_{xi',G} F by a scheme V, obtains two morphisms f_1, f_2 : U -> V over U, and shows that the fibre product h_U x_{xi, F x_G F} F is represented by the scheme V x_{Delta, V x V, (f_1,f_2)} U.
